assets.name: word
assets.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE square production-ready desktop app adapter icon for the WorkProof application. This belongs to a coherent six-icon family. Style: straight-on, perfectly upright dark evergreen rounded-square tile (#102420), with a very subtle satin rim and soft top-left illumination. A large pale mint (#b9f3d1) folded-ribbon glyph, with a restrained mint highlight and a single darker green fold, matches WorkProof's mint ribbon W brand icon. Elegant Windows desktop software quality, very simple, crisp, recognizable at 32 pixels. Tile occupies 86% of the square canvas, generous identical transparent outer margin, corner radius about 22% of tile width. No tilted tile, no perspective, no scene, no pedestal, no drop shadow outside the tile, no ornamental text, no watermark, no multiple icons, no mockup. The area OUTSIDE the rounded square must be genuinely transparent. Subject: Microsoft Word adapter. Glyph: one simple upright paper sheet with a folded upper-right corner and a clear capital W centered on the sheet. The W must be distinct and legible, with minimal extra detail.
